All quarks colour3; RH labels convert by conjugating BOTH colour and every flavour factor. Yu=(bar3Q,3U,1),Yd=(bar3Q,1,3D) complex scalars. Each flavour triplet is one gauge multiplet, NOT three additional copies.

Choose the source U3_U and U3_D fundamental-number generators as an explicit Abelian basis; UR/Psiu/Yu have U-number+1 and DR/Psid/Yd D-number+1, other source fields zero. These follow directly from U3 fundamental transformations and source Yukawa invariance, with RH conjugation applied after assignment. Ordinary SM leptons are inert under flavour and retain three copies.
